recordings.name: kepler_ellipse
recordings.title: Kepler orbit, e = 0.6
recordings.caption: One planet round a heavy sun, CVODE Adams, 360 frames of dt = 0.02 (t = 7.2, about two orbits). Watch the speed swing between perihelion and aphelion. Measured over the recording: |dE|/E = 9.8e-8, |dL|/|L| = 1.3e-7.

recordings.name: tumbling_racket
recordings.title: The tennis-racket theorem
recordings.caption: A torque-free cuboid (half-extents 1.6, 0.9, 0.25) spun about its INTERMEDIATE principal axis. It flips end over end — the Dzhanibekov effect — while the angular momentum stays put: measured |d|L||/|L| = 0 exactly, |dE|/E = 6.4e-9 over t = 4.

recordings.name: box_of_shapes
recordings.title: Mixed shapes in a rigid box
recordings.caption: The regression scenario mixed_shapes_rattle_in_the_box_conserving_energy: a cylinder, a disk and a cuboid inside a rigid BOX 4 whose six wall slabs have inverse_mass = 0, with G = 0. 36 real CVODE rootfinding events in t = 3; measured |dE|/E = 3.4e-16, i.e. exact to the last bit. Gold arrows are the analytic contact normals, scaled by the applied impulse. |L| about the origin is NOT conserved here, and should not be: the immovable walls supply outside torque.

recordings.name: double_pendulum_hinges
recordings.title: Double pendulum on two hinges
recordings.caption: Two HINGE joints — each fixing a point and an axis, each leaving one freedom — assembled into the classic chaotic linkage. 400 frames of dt = 0.01 (t = 4), every one a real IDA step on the constrained DAE. The gold rings are the joints; their axes run along z, straight at you in this opening view, so drag to see them. Measured: the joints hold to |g| = 5.6e-8 over the whole recording. Energy wanders by 4.5e-3 against a scale of mgL = 14.7 — 3 parts in 10,000 — and the same mechanism run as ONE continuous 4 s integration instead of 400 separate steps holds it to 7.4e-5, because each step restarts the multistep solver at order one.

recordings.name: universal_joint
recordings.title: A universal joint transmitting rotation
recordings.caption: A torque spins the input shaft up from rest; the Cardan joint carries the rotation across to the output shaft, which a rod braces to a post. The bend runs from straight to cos-inverse 0.6 = 53.130 degrees and back, and the speed ratio across the joint swings with it — a Cardan joint is not a constant-velocity joint.
